verdict.rationale: Snyk documents running its CLI (`snyk test`, `snyk code test`) in CI/CD pipelines, with a dedicated CI service-account role. PR-level results appear via inline comments in the PR. The pack never documents exit-code semantics for failing a build, and never documents gating only on new findings versus all findings. missing for 10: documented non-zero exit codes / build-failure behavior, new-findings-only (diff/baseline) gating, explicit per-PR CI check documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: You can also run the CLI in your CI/CD pipeline.
This Organization-level role allows service accounts in CI/CD pipelines to run basic Snyk CLI commands. The role grants permissions to run `snyk test` to check Projects for vulnerabilities
see the issues in the PR if you are using the inline comments capability
providing actionable insights directly in the developer workflow across IDEs, repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
